caption: The drawing depicts a U-shaped wooden object that appears to be a harness or yoke, illustrated in color as a central focus. The main object is composed of two symmetrical curved wooden arms that are joined at the top by a metal or rope connector, while the bottom ends are slightly separated. The wood is rendered in shades of brown, with visible grain patterns to convey texture. There are circular metal rings affixed at several points along the arms, indicated by their brownish-orange color. Additional lines and shading denote the three-dimensional form of the object, with the arms showing contours and beveled edges. Above the main image, there is an inset technical line drawing in a rectangular box, showing the profile and top view of one arm of the object, with two circular holes and a slightly curved shape. The background is plain, light beige or off-white, providing contrast to the detailed drawing of the object.
title: Horse Collar and Hame
